name: SM_Pepper_Red_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: red bell pepper, three lobes, about 9.5 cm tall with a 4 cm cut stalk, calyx collar and one leaf left on the stalk
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: Game material has no subsurface term, so the flesh reads a little harder than a real pepper in back light. The leaf is a 0.5 mm closed shell, not a translucent card. The body is one smooth parametric surface: no bruises, dents or asymmetry beyond the lobe warp. About 70 % of the UV square is used.
origin_ids_note: the family shares its origin IDs between all of its frames; this asset dresses the placements that show frame 421/18
